args.title: Freight Market Summary (2026) - Bellwether + Companion
args.body:
- Spot freight rates fell ~9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, signaling continued softening in the spot market relative to locked-in contracts.
- Fuel surcharges are now pegged to weekly diesel price movements, increasing short-term cost volatility for shippers.
- Companion piece finding: shippers who diversified volume across three carriers achieved the lowest overall freight costs, suggesting a multi-carrier strategy is currently optimal.
